description:
A woman on the verge of marriage gets caught up in an unexpected message from her once-obsessive ex-boyfriend.

Promising herself it will be “just one last time” to end things for good, she agrees to meet him.

But the feelings she buried long ago—and a dangerous kind of pleasure—are awakened again, and even after she’s married, her ex’s intrusions and their forbidden relationship refuse to end.

Torn between a peaceful future and corrupt desire, she finds herself trapped in a snare she can no longer escape…
